title: Bet: tent, house (2)
summary: Close-up study of the letter bet in red: three styles of the modern letter, its name, sound B, value 2, ancient tent/house pictograph and meaning "Tent, House", with a row showing the pictograph turning into an older rotated form and then into the Latin letters B and b.

letters.meaning: Tent, House (tent/house pictograph; becomes the Latin letters B and b)

pictures.description: Small ancient (paleo-Hebrew) pictograph of a tent or house floor plan, drawn above a red underline, shown between the number 2 and the words "Tent, House".
Evolution of the letter bet: the ancient tent/house pictograph on a red line, an arrow to an older rotated, simplified form, then arrows to a large red capital B and lower-case b.

keywords: second letter of the Hebrew alphabet
